findings.comment: Dimensioned floor plans showing unit layouts and dimensions are not provided for the two distinct unit types (2-bedroom and 3-bedroom townhomes). Site plan shows only building footprints and unit numbers without any interior floor plan details.
Floor area data table showing SF breakdown by floor (1st floor, 2nd floor, garage area, covered porch, patio) is not provided for the multi-story townhome units or condominium units.

Fire wall separation rating (1-hour or 2-hour) between townhome units is not noted on the cover sheet or floor plans. This information is required for townhome designs to demonstrate fire-rated separation between adjacent dwelling units.

findings.comment: Gross Floor Area (GFA) value on site plan sheet (83,986 sf) cannot be verified for consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application. Austin Water OWB comment OWB2 explicitly requests that GFA be added to site data table and verified consistent with benchmarking application, but the benchmarking application itself is not provided in submitted documents for cross-verification.

documentReferences.label: Completeness Check Results - Austin Water OWB Review

findings.comment: Building roof area value from site plan (32,296 sf building coverage per Site Data Table) cannot be verified for consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application. The benchmarking application is not provided in submitted documents, and Austin Water OWB comment OWB7 indicates pending updates required to this value.

Number of stories (maximum 3 stories documented on site plan) cannot be verified for consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application and project narrative. The benchmarking application document is not provided for cross-verification.

Fully accessible, Type A, and Type B adaptable dwelling units are not designated on the site plan, floor plans, or cover sheet. Residential buildings are required to identify which units meet these accessibility standards per the adopted 2024 International Building Code.

Site plan indicates project is subject to Subchapter E of the Land Development Code. However, documentation showing whether the shower and locker facilities Table B connectivity measure was elected is not provided. If this option was elected, no shower-and-changing facilities are shown on floor plans or site plan (39 units GFA < 100,000 sf would require minimum 2 facilities; GFA = 83,986 sf).

Multifamily building with 39 units exceeds the 20-unit threshold. Elevator requirement per IBC depends on whether fewer than 25% of units are located on the ground floor. Unit floor distribution by building is not documented on site plan, so compliance cannot be verified.

findings.comment: Site plan is a multifamily residential project (39 units) with Austin Water retail service, requiring a Water Benchmarking Application as a condition of site plan approval per LDC § 25-9-413. Benchmarking application is confirmed in review with Austin Water (multiple OWB comments pending), but neither the application document nor Austin Water director approval documentation is present on the site plan sheets. GFA (83,986 sf) is below the 250,000 SF large development threshold, so pre-release director consultation is not required, but director approval must be documented.
